value.rationale: A fixed four-update cutoff independent of arbitrarily many vertices is sharp, with a three-versus-four structural transition at singleton-only graphs. Three or more multipartite components exclude the primitive four-cycles appearing in bipartite excitable systems, and the exact seven-support inclusion–exclusion census determines all primitive orbits and the zeta function at every tuple of part sizes. This solves a natural global finite dynamical classification not supplied by qualitative eventual-periodicity theorems.
